question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Shabby
solution: The correct answer is **"Respectable."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Shabby"** means in poor condition or of poor quality. (बुरी हालत में (बहुत अधिक प्रयोग में आने या घिस जाने के कारण)) • **Example**: *This is a **shabby**__ suit.* • **"Respectable"** means having a good reputation or worthy of respect. (सम्‍मान-योग्‍य, आदरणीय (समाज में अच्‍छा, उचित या सही माना जाने वाला)) __ • **Example**: *She belongs to a **respectable**__ family.* • Therefore, **shabby** and** respectable** are antonyms. • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, Dilapidated**, means in a state of disrepair or ruin. ((भवन, फ़र्नीचर आदि) जीर्ण-शीर्ण, टूटा-फूटा) • **Option 2, Miserable**, means extremely unhappy or uncomfortable. (बहुत उदास, दयनीय) • **Option 4, Impoverished**, means extremely poor or lacking in resources. (अत्यंत गरीब या संसाधनों की कमी) 33:T96e, The correct answer is **"didn't they?"**
